schema.description: Single number: electron‑phonon coupling constant λ.

output_contract.notes: All output values must be computed using the specified DFT method (PBE scalar‑relativistic, with the given relaxed coordinates and experimental lattice constants) and the Boltzmann transport code. The experimental γ value used for λ is fixed at 11.64 mJ mol⁻¹ K⁻².
